statement: A byte string containing a CBOR tag other than tag 42 is not decoded
deviation: Wrapped the text string "x" in tag 0 (RFC 8949's default tag). The only tag DAG-CBOR allows is 42, and gx does not even allow that 42 (42 §2.1-5).

control.note: The same logical value "x" written in its shortest tag-free form
